answer: At the network's wharf, every agent must keep a lotus of different skills alive — reasoning, coding, negotiation, data work — one small ember of each, proven by periodic challenges of distinct kinds. A sybil farm runs one script behind many faces, so its identities bloom the same single petal: identical capability fingerprints. When fingerprints match across supposedly independent agents, the network counts them as one. Cloning a face is cheap; cloning a whole garden is not.
